title: USF-177 backup and restore provider disposition matrix

humanDecision.decisionSummary: pgBackRest backup/restore disposition is split by semantic requirement. DB/RLS and files proof may support bounded data-integrity posture only and are not equivalent to backup artifact creation, restore drills, RPO/RTO evidence, or disaster recovery readiness.

backupRestoreProviderDisposition.riskStatement: pgBackRest service catalogue presence, DB/RLS proof, files proof, or documentation could be mistaken for backup artifact creation, restore drill, RPO/RTO, disaster recovery, or production backup readiness.
backupRestoreProviderDisposition.treatment: Defer pgBackRest SDK/client/CLI/protocol selection, adapter implementation, backup artifact creation, restore drill, tenant and classification preservation, secret exclusion, audit evidence, retention, cleanup, failure handling, timeout, retry, teardown, incident, vulnerability, privacy, supplier, RPO/RTO, and resilience proof to USF-202.
backupRestoreProviderDisposition.deferredEvidence: USF-177 records the bounded disposition gate, non-equivalence boundary, runtime manifest deferral, enterprise evidence rows, validator coverage, and planted defects only.

dbProofSubstituteBoundary.substitutionNonEquivalenceBoundary: DB/RLS, files, retention, and local capability proof are not equivalent to pgBackRest backup artifact creation, restore invocation, restore success, backup integrity verification, RPO/RTO, scheduled backup posture, PITR, disaster recovery, provider unavailable handling, timeout, retry, audit operation evidence, retention execution, cleanup, supplier posture, or teardown behaviour.
scopeCovered: bounded local DB/RLS tenant-isolation proof where semantically permitted
bounded files metadata and retention/purge guard posture where semantically permitted
non-equivalence to pgBackRest backup and restore provider semantics
value-free repository evidence and validation linkage
limits: does not prove pgBackRest adapter binding
does not create a backup artifact
does not perform a restore drill
does not prove RPO or RTO
does not prove disaster recovery readiness
does not prove backup retention execution
does not prove secret exclusion from backup content
does not prove provider teardown or cleanup

providerBoundary.nonEquivalenceBoundary: pgBackRest remains a deferred backup/restore provider boundary until USF-202 proves backup artifact creation, restore drill semantics, tenant/classification preservation, secret exclusion, retention, audit evidence, failure handling, and cleanup.
